items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: because at that time look at the young guys that died like Bix Beiderbecke and millions of them from drinking too much

ctx.x: Oh, in the past she had thought it was?

Yes. You see, when I was going to school, there was a place in Kansas City called 'The Yellow Front'. And everybody went in there with knives and guns, nobody searched you. Every Saturday night somebody got murdered in this place. And it was during that time that my mother thought that jazz was just for low people and she says, she called this place a 'Bucket of Blood'. And she did not want me to play jazz. I don't think it was so much because of the music, but she figures all jazz was not—because at that time…
